Received.Name: Nirup Chahawan
Received.Feedback: I really appreciated your pace of work given our tight timescales. Your engagement in the daily check-ins for me to quickly provide feedback and for you to then turn around updates really helped to allay my concerns about your level of experience with bid writing. Despite being more junior, it was clear that you were carrying the bulk of the work compared to your more senior colleague. From my perspective, that did not come across well, as she should have been offering greater support rather than presenting your work. That said, it reflects well on you that you handled the situation as you did. For future situations like this, you could consider taking more ownership of the conversation. Using simple markers such as: 'What I’ve understood based on your feedback is...' 'The actions I will take away are...' 'You asked for x and here is what I’ve done in response…' This would help position you as being in control of your work and delivery, rather than allowing others to speak on your behalf. I appreciated your willingness to upskill in bid writing despite it being a new area for you and the fact that you are aligned to AED (so I assume not used to writing lengthy documents of prose - no offence). This is a true contribution to capability and the work we do at PA to bring new business in so while you may be low on UTE, it’s great that you are finding other ways to contribute to the engine of the business.
